The first speedcubing competition held in 6 years since 2017. Solo Comeback 2023 will be held at Solo Grand Mall in Solo, Central Java, Indonesia. This competition is open to all citizens. **We will not accept your registration if you have not confirmed it to us**. For further information, please contact the contact provided
